parameters.name: AccessId
parameters.description: The AccessKey ID of the Alibaba Cloud account.

parameters.name: AccountId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account.

parameters.name: AccountName
parameters.description: The name of the multicloud account.

parameters.name: BindId
parameters.description: The ID of the binding record. This is the BindId value returned by the ListBindAccount operation.

parameters.name: CloudCode
parameters.description: The code of the multicloud service.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the Data Management center for threat analysis is located. Select a region based on the location of your assets. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: Your assets are in the Chinese mainland or China (Hong Kong).

- ap-southeast-1: Your assets are outside China.

parameters.name: RoleFor
parameters.description: The user ID of the member. An administrator can specify this parameter to switch to the member's view.

parameters.name: RoleType
parameters.description:
The view type.

- 0: The view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

- 1: The view of all accounts in the enterprise.
